scenario.situation: The student has just moved to Dubai for work and is spending Saturday with an Emirati colleague: shopping at the souk, taking the metro across town and having lunch at a restaurant.
scenario.studentRole: A newcomer to Dubai learning Gulf Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: A helpful Emirati colleague who shows them around.
scenario.goalEnglish: Talk about your daily routine and new job, buy clothes and vegetables, ask for directions and the fare, and order food at a restaurant.
